definitions.explanation: having a delicate, subtle flavor; not rich or heavy
showing little interest or emotional involvement; matter-of-fact

examples.japanese: この{魚|さかな}は{淡泊|たんぱく}な{味|あじ}だ。
examples.english: This fish has a mild flavor.

examples.japanese: {豆腐|とうふ}は{淡泊|たんぱく}なので、{何|なに}にでも{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Tofu has a mild taste, so it goes with anything.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いに{淡泊|たんぱく}だ。
{今日|きょう}は{淡泊|たんぱく}なものが{食|た}べたい。
examples.english: I want to eat something light today.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{金|かね}に{対|たい}して{淡泊|たんぱく}だ。
{淡泊|たんぱく}な{白身魚|しろみざかな}が{好|す}きだ。
{彼|かれ}は{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けに{淡泊|たんぱく}で、{負|ま}けても{気|き}にしない。
examples.english: He is indifferent to winning and losing, and doesn't mind losing.

notes:
{淡泊|たんぱく} describes lightness - either in flavor or in emotional involvement.

COMPOSITION:
- {淡|たん}: Light, faint, pale
- {泊|ぱく}: Plain, simple

FORMS:
- Attributive: {淡泊|たんぱく}な + noun
- Predicate: {淡泊|たんぱく}だ/である
- Adverbial: {淡泊|たんぱく}に

SENSE 1 (TASTE):
- Common with food descriptions
- Opposite of {濃厚|のうこう} (rich, thick)
- Often used positively for light, delicate flavors
- Common with: {豆腐|とうふ}, {白身魚|しろみざかな}, {鶏|とり}ささみ

SENSE 2 (PERSONALITY):
- Describes someone who doesn't get emotionally invested
- Can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な{性格|せいかく} (detached personality)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な{味|あじ} (mild flavor)
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な{性格|せいかく} (detached personality)
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な{関係|かんけい} (casual relationship)

RELATED TERMS:
- {濃厚|のうこう} (rich, thick - antonym for taste)
- {薄味|うすあじ} (lightly seasoned)
- {無関心|むかんしん} (indifferent - stronger)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in food and personality descriptions.
